targets.rawSql: SELECT repo, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '/', SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ' (', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1), '%)') ELSE '-' END AS rate FROM dpv_builds WHERE repo IN (${repo:singlequote}) AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event GROUP BY repo ORDER BY repo

SELECT repo, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED' THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CONCAT('$', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED' THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 * 0.008, 2)) ELSE '-' END AS cost FROM dpv_builds WHERE repo IN (${repo:singlequote}) AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event GROUP BY repo ORDER BY repo

panels.title: 每日 passed build 中位時間（每 repo 一條，分鐘）

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, repo AS metric, median_min AS value FROM dpv_build_duration_daily WHERE repo IN (${repo:singlequote}) AND day >= $__timeFrom() AND day < $__timeTo() ORDER BY day

SELECT week AS time, repo AS metric, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN fails * 100.0 / denom ELSE 0 END AS value FROM dpv_failure_rate_weekly WHERE repo IN (${repo:singlequote}) AND week >= $__timeFrom() AND week < $__timeTo() ORDER BY week

panels.title: PR Review latency 週趨勢（median，小時）

targets.rawSql: SELECT week AS time, median_h AS value FROM dpv_pr_latency_weekly WHERE week >= $__timeFrom() AND week < $__timeTo() ORDER BY week

SELECT repo, external_id, pr_number, author_account, status, started_at FROM dpv_builds WHERE repo IN (${repo:singlequote}) AND is_failure AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() ORDER BY started_at DESC

panels.title: 高延遲 PR 清單（review latency 由高到低）

targets.rawSql: SELECT repo, number, author_account, ROUND(lat_h, 1) AS lat_h, unreviewed FROM dpv_pr_latency WHERE repo IN (${repo:singlequote}) AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() ORDER BY lat_h DESC LIMIT 50
